title: INC: Invoice PDF downloads failing
author: Miles Thornton
content:
h1. INC: Invoice PDF downloads failing

Status: resolved.

h1. Window
2027-02-03 15:10 UTC to 2027-02-03 17:45 UTC.

h1. Impact
Downloading an invoice PDF from the Console returned an error. Invoices, payments and autopay were not affected; invoice emails were sent as usual.

h1. Resolution
A certificate on the document service was renewed. Downloads work again.
